best_idea: A fixed-size bag where a find that cannot fit turns into currency shown in the same reveal, with set parts auto-combining on pickup and a battle loot plan bounded by free slots.
decision_why: Keep the full-bag-to-gold rule, set auto-assembly and slot-bounded loot plan in src/fight/loot.ts with capacity and gold values as zone data; reject the spell-book slot-0 rule and the Necromancy and scroll heuristics (HoMM2-specific). Donor defects fixed in sketch: ultimates stay with the loser (not erased) and the exchange returns leftovers instead of relying on an assert.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a 14-item bag killing into a chest gives 1000 gold to the one ledger and no item, and that the last of three set parts picked up yields the set item in the same tick with one message.
